provenance.citation: Mirarchi, Giorgino & De Fabritiis, Sci Data 11, 1299 (2024)
provenance.note: Five temperatures x five replicas; frames saved every 1 ns per the dataset description.

field.meaning: h: RMS change of site pair distances over the lag (nm); v: mean chart displacement; cov: conditional covariance of chart displacement; u: mean rigid-aligned site displacement.

nerve.scope: Full-data witnessed complex in a projected 2D chart; maximal simplices preserved; the drawing is the nerve of the face poset of the 2-skeleton. No configuration-space homotopy claim.

fluid_filtration.meaning: Nerve of the cover thickened by +-tau frames along each run. Monotone in tau. GF(2).

flooding.meaning: Sublevel sets of smoothed -log occupancy on the chart grid; cubical GF(2) Betti numbers; 0-dim pairs are exact basin merge levels (elder rule). Not a free energy.
